headlines.title: American Tower (AMT) Stock Price Dips As Q3 Results Lift Guidance
headlines.summary: American Tower just reported Q3 2026 and the share price slipped about 2.4% yesterday. That reaction leans more emotional than analytical. The headline story is not an earnings miss. It is that cash generation held up, with attributable adjusted funds from operations per share ticking higher and management lifting full year guidance again. Investors focused on the red screen. The fundamentals pointed to something quieter and more nuanced.

description: American Tower Corporation one of the largest global REITs, is a leading independent owner, operator and developer of multitenant communications real estate with a portfolio of over 147,000 communications sites and a highly interconnected footprint of U.S. data center facilities. American Tower Corporation was incorporated in 1995 in Delaware and is based in Massachusetts, Boston.
